verdict.rationale: Honcho does background work of its own: it reasons over stored messages, and its deriver and opt-in Dreamer working memory run behind the scenes. That is built-in memory processing, not a feature that lets users define and schedule their own autonomous automations. The evidence shows no user-configurable triggers, schedules or recurring workflows, so it counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
